protocol.noise: Independent Gaussian in E and cB; sigma=2% clean pooled component RMS.
protocol.selection: Per-seed noisy validation RMSE within training time interval; no future labels.
protocol.test: Noiseless dense phase grid [-3,3], translated to each test time; all target phases observed in training domain.
protocol.interpretation: Known direction and speed supplied to Maxwell stumps and phase random forest; both also enforce E=cB and average the two noisy targets. Controlled inductive-bias comparison, not discovery. Phase forest added as an attribution control after examining initial wave results.
protocol.equation_check: Exact distributional delta coefficients at every fitted constrained front; no finite-difference residual proxy.
